title: Worktree path authority
current: Candidate path recording validates client syntax independently of the server OS: POSIX absolute, Windows drive-rooted and complete backslash UNC paths round-trip without rewriting. Leading forward slashes keep POSIX meaning, including double-slash forms that resemble Windows namespaces. Backslash device namespaces, incomplete UNC and drive-relative or drive-unspecified paths refuse. Existing-checkout recovery uses the current active lane id and branch under the item work claim and preserves physical contents. This metadata change does not promise native Windows runtime support. The session-folder guard allows reads and writes beneath the executing user’s .cache and Library/Caches roots in every project. Sibling names and symlinks resolving outside those roots retain normal path authority checks. Standard tool-directory entries remain trusted when the individual executable is a symlink to an implementation outside those directories. That trust does not extend to the external implementation directory or to descendants reached through a directory symlink.
